title: Collections Note — An Employer-Liable Shortfall Open Alongside a Returned Remittance
content:
Another delinquency open at the same time adds to the late charge rate on a deduction schedule a returned remittance reinstated, under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement. The other item is the deduction schedule that the employer-liable shortfall notice booked most recently concerns, where that notice is the only one booked that day.

- Where that schedule still has an open amount of at least 40000 US dollars, 0.2 percentage points are added.
- Where that open amount is above zero but below 40000 US dollars, 0.1 percentage points are added.
- Otherwise, including when there is no such item, none.

There is no such item where the agreement carries no employer-liable shortfall notice or where more than one employer-liable notice was booked on the latest such day. The open amount is the schedule amount less the remittances and write-offs pointing to it, plus the remittance returns pointing to it.

Hypothetical cases: the shortfall's schedule open by 52000.00 adds 0.2 points; open by 1450.00 adds 0.1; cured in full adds none.
